name: brainbox
description: BrainBox 0.0.12: ten blank spots in About me instead of four. Adds the basic context a brain needs to be useful on day one - who else is in the business, how the money works, what is being worked on right now, what is on this quarter, how the owner wants to be spoken to, and what they want more and less of. The brain is told plainly not to fire them off as a form.
